r0.why: Names, bound on exceeding a value over time, martingale/submartingale scope and attribution all from 1,2,4,5 (Doob from the inequality's name in 1).

r1.why: Final expectation controls chance of exceeding earlier (9); running maximum bounded by terminal expectation, tool for extreme path behavior (3).

r2.why: Direct proof without restrictive assumptions (10), property used once with conditional expectation (14), stopped-submartingale reading and minimal index as stopping time (15,16).

r3.why: Right/left continuity needed only for countable dense subset sup (11), flexibility via increasing finite sets (20), general index sets (21).

r4.why: Further Doob inequalities (22), martingale or positive submartingale with right-continuous paths (23), Jensen for |X|^p (24), layer cake + Holder gives maximal inequality (25,26).

r5.why: Partial sums martingale (27), |S_n| nonnegative submartingale by Jensen (28), which is precisely Kolmogorov's inequality (29).

r6.why: Precursor to BDG two-sided bounds via quadratic variation (30), p=2 foundational to Ito integral (31), step to convergence theorems and no infinite oscillation enabling a.s. convergence (34-36).
